The Lab/2015

Karya

May 2015 · Apps & tools

My to-do app for choosing three priorities each day.

Dates & sources

The first surviving commit is dated 11 May 2015; the last is from November 2015.

Archived site · 13 December 2015 ↗

I built Karya around a short list: three priorities in the morning, then a check-in at night. Choosing what goes on the list is part of using it.

You can try that idea below. This version saves your list in your browser and doesn’t use the original app’s accounts or server.

Three things for today

Choose three priorities. Your list is saved in this browser.
